statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(basename "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')"); branch=$(cd "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')" && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // "?"'); thinking_enabled=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.thinking.enabled // false'); effort_level=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // ""'); thinking_str=""; [ "$thinking_enabled" = "true" ] && { label="T"; [ -n "$effort_level" ] && label="T:$effort_level"; thinking_str=" [$label]"; }; branch_str=""; [ -n "$branch" ] && branch_str=" ($branch)"; printf "%s%s | %s%s | %s%% free" "$dir" "$branch_str" "$model" "$thinking_str" "$remaining"
